data.desc: Avino is a primary silver-focused mining company with the advantages of being both a producer and a developer. The Company operates the producing Avino Mine and is advancing the La Preciosa Mine, both located in the state of Durango, Mexico. La Preciosa is a production and development-stage mineral property, hosting one of Mexico's largest undeveloped primary silver resources. The Company's silver, gold and copper production remains unhedged. Avino has been recognized in the Toronto Stock Exchange's TSX30 for two consecutive years, ranking 5th in both 2025 and 2026. The Company remains focused on executing its transformational growth strategy, with the objective of building sustainable, profitable mining operations that create long-term value for shareholders and benefit the communities in which we operate. Responsible mining practices remain an integral part of Avino's operations, including the successful operation of its dry-stack tailings facility for more than three years.
